text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Islington Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Islington Avenue and Orrell Avenue/Finchley Road. Traffic control signals will provide enhanced safety for vulnerable road users.

City Council on December 16, 17 and 18, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Islington Avenue and Orrell Avenue/Finchley Road.
